svg.title: Mouse · Gray
svg.desc: Compact gray laboratory mouse with silver-gray dorsal fur, lighter ventral fur, large pinnae, pointed muzzle, and a thin tail. Biological basis: Dilution alleles reduce the apparent concentration or distribution of dark pigment, producing slate-to-silver coat tones without changing mouse anatomy.
